policy.use: Internal research training of an independent detector (Turniting AI Detector V1). No dataset or derived dataset is redistributed; raw/normalized data and weights are kept local and out of Git.
policy.exclusion_rule: A dataset is EXCLUDED_LICENSE only if its licence clearly forbids research training. Access-restricted sources are BLOCKED_ACCESS, not licence exclusions.
policy.text_in_reports: Raw text snippets appear in reports only for permissive licences (MIT, Apache-2.0, CC-BY). NC/ND/SA/unspecified sources are reported by dataset + sample id + score only.

datasets.redistribution_constraints: Non-commercial; no redistribution of adapted/derived versions of the dataset. Organizers ask to be contacted (organizers.autextification@gmail.com) to adapt or build upon it. Commercial deployment of a model trained on it needs organizer permission.
datasets.citation: Sarvazyan et al. Overview of IberAuTexTification at IberLEF 2024. Procesamiento del Lenguaje Natural 73 (2024).
datasets.notes: Primary Spanish/Iberian source (ca, en, es, eu, gl, pt). Used locally for research training only; normalized copy is never redistributed.

datasets.redistribution_constraints: Non-commercial; share-alike for adaptations. Commercial use of the trained model needs clearance.
datasets.citation: Sarvazyan et al. Overview of AuTexTification at IberLEF 2023. Procesamiento del Lenguaje Natural 71 (2023). arXiv:2309.11285.
datasets.notes: English + Spanish. Official test set uses domains not present in train (news, reviews).

datasets.redistribution_constraints: Licence permissive, but files are access-restricted: the Zenodo record requires the owners to approve an access request.
datasets.citation: Macko et al. MULTITuDE: Large-Scale Multilingual Machine-Generated Text Detection Benchmark. EMNLP 2023.
datasets.notes: No official open mirror exists (HF search returns unrelated repos). An access request must be submitted by the project owner on Zenodo; not done automatically. Not a licence exclusion.

datasets.source: https://zenodo.org/records/11002158 (official data archive SemEval2024-Task8-data.zip); task repo https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/SemEval2024-task8
datasets.license: Not declared on Zenodo/GitHub (public shared-task release for research)
datasets.redistribution_constraints: No explicit licence: treat as research-only, no redistribution. Underlying human texts come from M4 sources with their own terms.
datasets.citation: Wang et al. SemEval-2024 Task 8: Multidomain, Multimodel and Multilingual Machine-Generated Text Detection. SemEval 2024.
datasets.notes: Subtask A binary (mono+multilingual, official gold test included); Subtask B generator metadata; Subtask C mixed human->machine boundary texts kept as MIXED only. Preferred over the third-party HF mirror d0rj/SemEval2024-task8.

datasets.license: Not declared in repository (public research benchmark)
datasets.redistribution_constraints: No explicit licence: research-only, no redistribution. Underlying sources (Wikipedia, WikiHow, Reddit, arXiv, PeerRead, ...) keep their own terms.
datasets.citation: Wang et al. M4: Multi-generator, Multi-domain, and Multi-lingual Black-Box Machine-Generated Text Detection. EACL 2024.
datasets.notes: Each row pairs human_text and machine_text for the same source_ID; both kept in the same group. Overlaps SemEval-2024 Task 8 (handled by dedup + group union).

datasets.redistribution_constraints: Apache-2.0; underlying human sources keep their own terms.
datasets.citation: Li et al. MAGE: Machine-generated Text Detection in the Wild. ACL 2024. arXiv:2305.13242.
datasets.notes: LABEL SEMANTICS INVERTED: official label 0 = machine-generated, 1 = human-written (github.com/yafuly/MAGE README; verified: every *_human src has label 1). Normalized to 0=HUMAN,1=MACHINE.

datasets.redistribution_constraints: Attribution + share-alike for redistributed adaptations (none redistributed).
datasets.citation: Guo et al. How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. arXiv:2301.07597.
datasets.notes: English + Chinese. Each answer is a sample; group = question to avoid leakage.

datasets.citation: Dugan et al. RAID: A Shared Benchmark for Robust Evaluation of Machine-Generated Text Detectors. ACL 2024. arXiv:2405.07940.
datasets.notes: train.csv (~11.8 GB, labelled, includes 11 adversarial attacks). Processed in streaming chunks; stratified sample by model/domain/attack/decoding/repetition_penalty. extra.csv and unlabeled test.csv not used.

datasets.redistribution_constraints: Apache-2.0; news articles keep publisher terms.
datasets.citation: Uchendu et al. TURINGBENCH: A Benchmark Environment for Turing Test in the Age of Neural Text Generation. Findings of EMNLP 2021.
datasets.notes: ADDITIONAL. 19 older generators (GPT-1/2/3, GROVER, CTRL, XLNet, ...), English news. TT_* binary folders used; AA attribution folder skipped (same texts).

datasets.citation: Verma et al. Ghostbuster: Detecting Text Ghostwritten by Large Language Models. NAACL 2024. arXiv:2305.15047.
datasets.notes: ADDITIONAL. Student essays (academic) with ChatGPT and Claude counterparts written from the same prompt; group = essay id.
